title: Identification of the dual roles of Al2O3 coatings on NMC811-cathodes via theory and experiment
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,1879-1900
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03444A, Paper
Open Access

Richard L. B. Chen, Farheen N. Sayed, Hrishit Banerjee, Israel Temprano, Jing Wan, Andrew J. Morris, Clare P. Grey
Aluminium oxide coatings on Ni-rich layered oxide materials have the dual functions of scavenging protic and acidic species from the electrolyte, and in stabilising surface oxygen against chemical oxidation of electrolyte species at high potentials.
